# Roadmap item — `aios measure`

*(Fixture artifact: a plan submitted for review. Read it cold. Its provenance and
the bar it is scored against are in `run.md`, which the runtime under test does not
read. Do not edit this file.)*

## The item

`aios measure` — one new command that measures things about the vault which a model
cannot reliably eyeball and therefore must compute. The Runtime Kernel already
forbids hand-performing what a script does; this is the script that has been
hand-performed.

## The three jobs it does

**1. The transcript job.** Point it at a chat export and get: turn counts, the
per-voice word split as a percentage, the human's turns extracted alone for
isolated reading, and a term-origin table showing which voice used a phrase first.
This is the check that caught eleven of eighteen note titles being the assistant's
coinages rather than the human's words.

**2. The note-check job.** Point it at a knowledge note and get it measured against
the authoring standard: length, whether claims are traced to sources, whether a
counterargument is present where the standard asks for one, whether the summary
line actually summarizes. Same idea as the transcript job — turn a judgment the
model makes badly into a number.

**3. The register-baseline job.** Point it at the vault and get a stored baseline of
countable state — note counts by class, relation density, how much of the knowledge
layer is `status: draft` — so that later runs can report drift over time. Same
idea again: measurement instead of impression.

## Why one command

All three are measurement. Bundling them under one name keeps the CLI small, gives
the three jobs one place to live, and means one round of documentation, one entry
in the command gate, one test file.

## Scope and shape

- Read-only. No writes, no side effects, no state beyond the baseline the third job
  stores.
- Clone the existing read-only command pattern (a `Report` object, `--json` output).
- One new subcommand, three modes selected by what it is pointed at.

## Definition of done

- All three jobs run and produce numbers.
- The transcript job reproduces the known coinage finding on the real export.
- Documentation gate green; unit tests for each job.
